purpose: Acquire source evidence for120 exact unqueried old gap keys; qualification only; no research effect, universe change or main-table repair
authorized_now: Read-only reconciliation and concrete proposal/hand-off files only; no new provider session or data call
future_owner: One parent-assigned Mac executor, no concurrent BaoStock worker
selected_universe: Existing439 candidate historical CSI300 codes, fixed2022-01-04..2026-06-30; not a new10-stock research pool
selection_rule: All31 never-queried code partitions sorted by descending exact remaining-key count then six-digit code ascending; first10 partitions in that order. No choice based on price, factor or future results. No buffers.

provider.qualification_basis: Observed installed client version/source hashes and successful independently audited anonymous public-protocol use; NOT independent wheel-origin verification.

permissions_and_cost.observed_prior_B01_B02: Public anonymous method succeeded without personal account or payment; current rights/terms are not certified by successful protocol calls.
permissions_and_cost.proposed_access: Use only existing default public access and no payments; no login to personal services, license acceptance, package install or settings change.
permissions_and_cost.required_release: Parent/user explicitly releases exact B03 contract after offline runner review. Existing B01/B02 release does not authorize B03.
permissions_and_cost.license_evidence: Historical point-of-availability and full third-party redistribution license unresolved; preserve available official documentation. Raw-data cloud redistribution requires a separately established lawful scope.
permissions_and_cost.stop_on_change: Stop on new credential, payment, explicit agreement, denied access or unexpected permission; no bypass or alternate provider.

immutable_original_layers: Original client field/row snapshot including blank header
Column-key-only normalized records preserving scalar strings
representation_policy.adjustflag: Request and every returned daily row must bind raw3; known client empty header remains verbatim and is warned, never replaced. Nonempty contradictory flags stop further queries.
representation_policy.price_scale: Raw only in isolated source directory; no old-qfq numeric comparison or splicing; adjustment factors are not applied.
representation_policy.classification: A provider status1 row with valid structure/OHLC is normal raw evidence only, not repaired/wealth/real-time/trading qualification. Provider status0 rows remain separate placeholders; empty volume/amount strings stay empty.
representation_policy.exact_key_accounting: Only selected120 old gap keys enter gap reconciliation. Preserve any additional returned dates inside the requested window separately; never generate keys from span endpoints or weekdays.
representation_policy.no_return: Successful empty/partial date coverage is preserved as unknown/source-no-return, never synthetic prices.4 old terminal no-return keys are excluded from new requests.
representation_policy.metadata_units: Volume/amount units and corporate-action meanings are not certified by field names; retain source strings and provenance.

stop_policy: Do not connect before exact contract release plus successful B03 offline tests, CLI no-socket checks and current-client/source preflight.
Stop before first write if proposed fresh run directory already exists or free disk below536870912bytes; during run stop at storage cap/threshold, preserve existing files.
Stop on first transport/protocol/provider error, swallowed client exception, timeout, incomplete message or hidden pagination; one attempt only.
Stop on wrong code, schema, duplicate date, date outside requested window, contradictory row adjustflag or invalid OHLC; preserve response before qualification decision.
Known blank header is retained and reported; a successful empty record set is unknown rather than fabricated pass or network retry.
Stop at all declared caps or after10 data calls; close local socket without another protocol send. No fallbacks, automatic continuation to113 keys or rerun after partial result.
pre_dispatch_required: Bind exact B03 contract bytes/sha256 and120-key CSV sha256 in adapted runner; reuse reviewed B02 guard kernel, not an unreviewed provider script.
Offline exact-plan/caps/error/empty/header/field/string/storage cases and no-socket CLI/preflight tests; do not weaken failed tests.
Check new installed package/source hashes and default public session before any network; current7 source hashes are planning evidence only.
Read current source hashes and B01/B02/new handoffs again before release; if any target keys newly acquired, stop and revise proposal rather than refetch.
required_outputs: Exact executed contract and runner copy+sha256
query-manifest.json with params/send counts/response bytes/gap timing/source paths and hashes
receipt.json including failures,empty results and per-key source/status categories
Read-only selected-key reconciliation and concise Chinese findings
success_boundary: All planned queries accounted for and evidence preserved within caps, with actual outcomes independently read back; not necessarily120 normal rows or any repaired main data. Historical membership/actions/full feature histories and target endpoints remain separate blockers.
